say:1:1064405001:0.text: The few remaining soldiers stand back to back, their ragged breaths cutting through the tense silence. Hypofiends surround them on all sides, yet not one of them lowers their weapon.
say:1:1064405001:0.source_cn: 风雪中，所剩无几的士兵背靠背，呼吸沉重，魔物已将他们...

say:4:1064405003:0.text: As the Hypofiend's claws slash through Raymond's arm, Russell swiftly hacks off its arm. Raymond cries out in pain but refuses to fall.
say:4:1064405003:0.source_cn: 一只魔物利爪贯穿莱默尔的手臂，罗塞挥剑将其斩断，前者发...

say:7:1064405005:0.text: Noticing the soldiers' broken weapons, the Hypofiends sense their chance to deal the killing blow...
say:7:1064405005:0.source_cn: 当士兵们的武器卷刃、绽出裂纹，魔物准备发出致命一击时……

say:8:1064405006:0.text: Suddenly, a deafening roar changes everything... Wind and snow converge into a cloak that drapes a towering figure.
say:8:1064405006:0.source_cn: 一声怒吼撕裂凛冬……无尽风雪聚作战袍，披挂在一个高大的...

say:12:1064405007:0.text: Standing before Russell and Raymond, Alna raises her hand, instantly restoring their weapons with ice.
say:12:1064405007:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜矗立在二人身前，抬手，锐利的寒冰覆上士兵们残破的...

say:13:1064405008:0.text: You are both honorable soldiers. The northern wind will remember your names.
say:13:1064405008:0.source_cn: 你们没有辜负战士的身份，北风会铭记这一刻。

say:14:1064405009:1.text: Now, raise your weapons and charge with me!
say:14:1064405009:1.source_cn: 现在，举起武器，随我冲锋！

say:15:1064405010:0.text: The blustery wind sweeping over Resford suddenly changes its direction. Riding the gale, Alna hurls herself into the sea of Hypofiends!
say:15:1064405010:0.source_cn: 吹向安息城的寒风，在此刻转向。阿尔娜乘着倒卷的寒风，冲...

say:19:1064405011:0.text: Foolish mortal, I'll reserve the worst spot in the abyss for your soul!
say:19:1064405011:0.source_cn: 不自量力的凡人，我会在深渊，为你的灵魂挑选一个饱受折磨...

say:23:1064405014:0.text: An icy spear pierces the Hypogean, freezing it into an ice sculpture that shatters the next instant.
say:23:1064405014:0.source_cn: 冰枪贯穿恶魔统领，它的身躯冻结为一座冰雕，随后在寒风中粉碎。

say:25:1064405015:0.text: Alna dances gracefully, every movement unleashing a deadly blizzard that slays the Hypofiends.
say:25:1064405015:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜在风雪中起舞，每一个动作都牵引出一片冰封的死亡，...

say:26:1064405016:0.text: The surviving soldiers regroup and follow closely behind Alna. Locking their cracked shields into a wall and leveling their broken spears, they drive into the Hypofiends.
say:26:1064405016:0.source_cn: 残存士兵重整队列，裂盾并作盾墙，断矛前指，追随阿尔娜的...

say:29:1064405017:0.text: For General Alna! For Resford! Charge!
say:29:1064405017:0.source_cn: 为了阿尔娜将军！为了安息城！冲啊——！

say:32:1064405019:0.text: Leaderless, the Hypofiends are utterly routed by Alna and the soldiers.
say:32:1064405019:0.source_cn: 失去了恶魔统领，在阿尔娜与剩余士兵的打击下，魔物大军彻...

say:33:1064405020:0.text: The Hypofiends... They're gone! We did it!
say:33:1064405020:0.source_cn: 魔物……魔物真的被打退了！安息城守住了！

say:34:1064405021:0.text: It's all because of General Alna! ... Wait, where's she? She was just here...
say:34:1064405021:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜将军！是她救了我们……欸，将军呢？刚才还能看到……

say:35:1064405022:0.text: The surviving soldiers help one another to their feet. The wind still howls, but Alna has vanished without a trace.
say:35:1064405022:0.source_cn: 幸存士兵相互搀扶，阿尔娜不知何时已然消失，只有寒风依然盘旋。

narration:38:1064405023:0.text: Three days later, Merlin returns to Resford, now a peaceful, warm city.
narration:38:1064405023:0.source_cn: 三天后，梅林赶回复归平静的安息城

say:41:1064405024:0.text: Merlin faces the biting wind and speaks softly, as if conversing with winter itself.
say:41:1064405024:0.source_cn: 梅林面对寒风，轻声开口，仿佛在与凛冬对话。

say:42:1064405025:0.text: Alna, from this day forward, you have become the embodiment of winter.
say:42:1064405025:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜，从此之后，你的意志将与风雪同频，你的足迹将随寒...

say:43:1064405026:0.text: Cold and solitude will be your lifelong companions. Do you regret your choice?
say:43:1064405026:0.source_cn: 四季轮转，与你相随的，皆是与温暖背离的孤寂。你是否后悔？

say:44:1064405027:0.text: The wind falls still for a brief moment. Then, an authoritative voice drifts from the swirling snow...
say:44:1064405027:0.source_cn: 呼啸的寒风似乎凝结了片刻，随后，一个威严的声音自雪花晶...

say:45:1064405028:0.text:
No. Even the strongest city walls will one day crumble.
I'd rather strike first with my spear.
say:45:1064405028:0.source_cn: 不。固守的城墙，终有被侵蚀磨灭的一刻。\n而我，更愿成...

say:46:1064405029:0.text: As the voice fades away, the blizzard that has battered Resford for days finally subsides. Sunlight spills through the clouds, enveloping the entire city in warmth.
say:46:1064405029:0.source_cn: 声音消散的刹那，笼罩安息城多日的风雪拂散，阳光破云而出...
